candidate_relations.reason: The clinical and radiographic findings—proportionate short stature, open fontanel with Wormian bones, diffuse osteosclerosis, acro-osteolysis, and characteristic craniofacial and distal phalangeal changes—support pycnodysostosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Same diagnosis; “pyknodysostosis” is a spelling variant of pycnodysostosis, with short stature as a characteristic manifestation.
